meta.source: Ported from QLC+ fixture WLED-Controller.qxf (WLED project DMX modes)
meta.notes: WLED's DMX-input personalities. Effect Mode ID enumerates WLED effects 0-25 by name (26-255 are a range); Effect Palette ID is a numeric palette selector. Pixel modes expose each LED's R/G/B(/W) directly. Pick the mode matching your WLED 'DMX mode' setting and LED count.
